9. Every appointed member of the Council shall, unless he
vacates office earlier by resignation, death or removal, hold
office  for  a  period  of  three  years  from  the  date  of  his
appointment  and  unless  is  removed  from  office,  shall  be
eligible for reappointment for not more than one further term,
whether consecutive or otherwise.
10. (1) Any appointed member of the Council may at any
time, resign from his office by a letter to that effect, addressed
to the Minister, and such resignation shall be effective from
the date on which it is accepted by the Minister in writing.
(2)  Where  any  appointed  member  by  reason  of  illness,
infirmity or absence from Sri Lanka is temporarily unable to
discharge the functions of his office, the Minister may, having
regard to the provisions of paragraph (b) of section 6, appoint
some other person to act in his place during his absence.
